scores.tell: Slightly dim red vignette at corners; otherwise bright key with clear white-cup-on-red value separation.
Dark navy hero on mid-blue is mostly separated by value, but the dark mass takes a large area and the corners go darker than the real cards.
Hero and floor are mid-orange and close in value; the pink background is flat. Hero separates by hue more than by value, and the lower half is murky.
Whole card sits in a pale, low-contrast range. White plane against pale clouds has weak value separation, and there are no strong darks.
Bright key with a glow behind the booth and dark accents in the base and phone. Close to the real cards; the base is a little heavy.
Busy scene with no single hero value group. Mid-value greens fill most of the card, and the pale stone hero blends into the grass.
Bright cyan background with glow, and a mid-orange saddle with gentle local contrast. Matches the grade-5 saddle.
Glow behind the hero and clear value separation. The dark navy truss is a slightly large dark area, but it is in line with the real cards.
Bright key with a light-ray backdrop, and a yellow duck that separates strongly. The sand at the bottom is slightly busy.
Dark teal body with a hard-edged bright rim and a flat orange pattern. Slightly higher local contrast and a heavier dark mass than the real cards.
